paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, anam pumpi ua Jordan lui agalkah siang nung un, TOUPA'N Joshua kiang ah,
heading: Theihgigena Suangte Phuh Ahi

paite: "Mipite lak a mi sawm-le-nih, nam chih a mi khat zel telkhia inla,
akiang uah, Jordan lui lai, siampute dinna laitak a suangte sawm-le-nih la unla, pophei unla, giahphual, tuzan a na giahna ding uah koih un, chi in thu pia in," achi hi.
Huchi in Joshua in Israel suante lak a mi sawm-le-nih, nam chih a mi khat zel atelkhiakte asam a;
Joshua in akiang uah, "TOUPA na Pathian uh bawm ma ah Jordan lui lai ah galkah unla, Israel suante anam zah zel in, michih in suang khat chiat pua hen.
Hiaite na lak uah chiamtehna ahong hi ding a, tunung chiang in na tate un, hiai suangte bang na chihna uh ahia? chỉ a ahon dot chiang un,

Nou akiang uah, TOUPA thukhun bawm ma a Jordan tuite ahong kan tak ziak in ahi. Jordan akan lai un, Jordan tuite ahong kitat a ahi. Hiai suangte Israel suante'n tangtawn a atheihgigena ding uh ahi, na chi ding uh," achi hi.
Israel suante'n Joshua thupiak bang in ahih ua, Israel suante'n anam zah zel in, Jordan lui lai a suang sawm-le-nih ala ua; agiahphual uah, apophei ua, huai ah akoih uhi.
Thukhun bawm zawng siampute dinna laitak, Jordan lui lai ah Joshua in huai suang sawm-le-nihte aphut a; huaite tuni tan in a-om lai uhi.

Mosi in Joshua thu ana piak tengteng bang a TOUPA'N mipite kiang a hih dia Joshua thu apiak ahihzoh vek mateng uh siampu bawm zawngte Jordan lui lai ah adingh nilouh uhi. Mipite akinoh ua, agalkahta uhi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, mipi tengteng agalkah siang vek nung un, TOUPA bawm leh siampute leng mipi mitmuh in agalkahta uhi.
heading: Jordan Lui Kante Kivolhdan

paite: Reuben suante, Gad suante leh Manasseh nam kimkhatte Mosi in akiang ua ana gen khitsa bang in, Israel suante ma ah kigalthuam in agalkah uhi.
Galvan a kivan dimdiam mi singli vel galdou ding in Jeriko phaizang ah TOUPA ma ah agalkah uhi.
Huai ni in TOUPA'N Israel tengteng mitmuh in Joshua atawisang a; Mosi alauh mah bang un adamsung teng in amah alau uhi.
TOUPA'N Joshua kiang ah thu agen a:
"Siampute, thu theihpihna bawm zawngte Jordan lui a pan hong pawt ding in thu pia in," achi hi.
Joshua in siampute, "Jordan lui a pan hong pawtta un," chi in thu apia hi.

Huan hichi ahong hi a, siampute, TOUPA thukhun bawm zawngte Jordan lui lai a pan ahong pawt ua, siampute khete'n leihul asiktak in, Jordan tuite aluan ngeina bang un ahong luang nawn ua, ama a mah bang in akuang ah aluanglet nawn hi.
Mipite akha khatna, ani sawm ni in Jordan lui a pan apawt ua, Jeriko suahlam pang Gilgal ah giahphual asatta uhi.
heading: Gilgal A Giahphual Bawlna

paite: Jordan lui a pan suang sawm-le-nih apuakkhiak uh, Joshua in Gilgal ah aphut hi.
Israel suante kiang ah, "Tunung chiang a na suante un apate uh kiang a, hiai suangte bang chihna ahia? chi a hon dot chiang un,
Israelte'n Jordan lui leihul ah agalkah ua ahi, chi in na suante uh na theisak ding uhi.'
TOUPA na Pathian un nidanglai a Tuipi San i galkah masiah ua, i ma ua ana kangtatsak mah bang in, TOUPA na Pathian un Jordan tuite na galkah masiah uh na ma uah akangtatsak a ahi.
Lei a nam chiteng in TOUPA khut ana hat ngei, chih atheih ua, TOUPA na Pathian uh tangtawn a alauhtheihna ding un," chi in agen hi.
